energy.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create one finished premium Korean fantasy RPG inventory material icon named Arden Energy, as a new original asset. This belongs to the same set as luxurious platinum-white armor with fine polished gold filigree and deep emerald/teal gemstones.
Subject: a single concentrated luminous emerald energy crystal, a substantial elongated faceted jewel with a bright mint-white heart and rich transparent teal depths. Cradle the crystal in an elegant architectural platinum-and-gold reliquary: two restrained swept protective fins, a small crown-like top clasp, a tapered base, and one delicate tilted elliptical gold orbit partly behind the crystal. The jewel should dominate, approximately two thirds of the object area; no armor, no character, no piles of gems. The shapes should be refined and coherent, with much less visual clutter than an overdecorated crown. Fine gold engraving only on a few broad platinum surfaces. Soft emerald light is contained inside the jewel and reflects off nearby metal. Crisp bright faceted planes and tasteful depth.
Style: exceptionally polished hand-painted 2D fantasy game item illustration, high material clarity, clean silhouette, smooth precise edges, rich premium finish, excellent readability at 64 and 128 pixels. Not photorealistic, not a plastic 3D toy, not flat vector.
Composition: one isolated vertically oriented object centered on a SQUARE canvas, subtle three-quarter perspective, fill about 78% width and 82% height. Generous real transparent padding at every edge; all fins, ring and glow wholly in frame. No rectangular inventory/card frame.
Color palette: platinum white, champagne gold, emerald and cool teal, controlled mint highlights. No purple, no red jewels.
Output: one square high-resolution PNG with a genuinely TRANSPARENT background and clean alpha. No scenery, ground plane, cast shadow, opaque backdrop, checkerboard pattern, labels, words, letters, numbers, UI, logo, watermark, floating debris or unrelated props.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Create one finished premium Korean fantasy RPG inventory material icon: SECRET WEAPON BLUEPRINT, CHAPTER I. It is the first of three DIFFERENT collectible pages, NOT a quantity bundle. New original asset, exactly ONE document.

Near overhead view with a subtle dimensional tilt. Large uninterrupted flat drawing area. Luxurious tactile paper, clean material finish, a fine inset gold border printed ON the document, NOT an outer inventory frame. Restrained elaborate craftsmanship, no excessive ribbons, scroll rods or clutter.
The central illustration printed flat on the vellum is one bold ornamental outline of an entirely fictional long magitech energy weapon in side profile, resembling a fantastical ceremonial rail-lance with a continuous straight body/barrel axis, an emerald abstract central jewel and a long sleek platinum-gold silhouette. Use ivory and gold luminous line art with restrained turquoise ink. This is fictional decorative heraldic artwork for a game inventory icon, with no dimensions, labels, real mechanical internals, actionable engineering, exploded construction or assembly instructions. The large elegant silhouette occupies most of the document face. Only a few faint abstract geometric arcs behind it. Keep the complete fictional weapon rigid and STRAIGHT from rear body to tip; never bend or kink the forward barrel.
At the lower center of the document, integrate one substantial dark enamel and gold rectangular seal plaque with the exact Roman numeral "I", large, ivory-gold, clean and immediately readable at thumbnail size. It indicates CHAPTER I, not number of papers. No other letters or words.
Style: refined hand-painted 2D Korean fantasy item illustration, high-end painterly vellum and polished metal, confident broad forms, uncluttered layout, clear at 64–128 pixels, not photograph, not flat vector. Matching platinum/gold/teal fantasy crafting material family.
Composition: one coherent isolated square icon, document fully in frame, around 80% canvas width and height, at least 8% clear transparent padding around every edge.
Output: square high-resolution RGBA PNG with genuinely TRANSPARENT background and clean alpha. No tabletop, scene, floor, drop shadow outside the object, outer card border, checkerboard texture, particles, logos, watermark, extra paper sheets or physical weapon in front of the drawing. No purple.
